knobs.note: BH-9786: the time budget of one route load. A load whose ttfb_ms or total_ms is above it is over budget (bin/lib/perf-probe/budget.sh, pp_route_verdict). Code fallback ${PERF_PROBE_BUDGET_MS:-1000}.
BH-9786: the size budget of one route load (the HTML document curl downloads). Above it the route is over budget (bin/lib/perf-probe/budget.sh). Code fallback ${PERF_PROBE_BUDGET_BYTES:-512000}.
BH-9786: the gap after each route load, so the probe adds no load spike to the client's app (ppio_load in bin/lib/perf-probe-io.sh). 0 = no pause. Code fallback ${PERF_PROBE_PAUSE_MS:-500}.
BH-9786: curl --max-time of the session POST and of each route load. A slow route is still measured; a hung one answers 000 and the lane goes on. Code fallback ${PERF_PROBE_TIMEOUT_S:-30}.

BH-9786: how long the lane waits for locks/perf-probe-<project>.lock before it logs skip: lock busy and goes to the next project. A bound, not a queue; 0 = do not wait. Code fallback ${PERF_PROBE_LOCK_WAIT_S:-600}.
Test seam: the ISO time bin/perf-probe.sh and bin/lib/perf-probe-io.sh use as now (the result day and the session expiry check). Unset on a box. NOT settable from the control plane.

Test seam: the jobs client path bin/perf-probe.sh calls for results-put (tests/perf-probe.bh-9786-test.sh points it at a stub). Unset on a box: $HARNESS/bin/jobs-client.sh. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: 1 lets pp_row_valid (bin/lib/perf-probe.sh) accept a base_url of http://127.0.0.1[:port], the test fake. Unset on a box: only https:// rows are valid. NOT settable from the control plane.
